name: Kashiwagi Ayano
source:
The strongest and worst "flesh pot" in the story of Kisaku.
She is the female version of Kisaku, who will stop at nothing to achieve her ambitions. She has political power, and uses a mixture of slow and fast techniques.
She is a woman who will never give in just because someone sticks their dick in her.

[Translated from the [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20040429210739/http://www.elf-game.co.jp/net_shop/soft/special/kisaku/kisaku5.html]game's website, archived[/url]]
